title: The Random Mod
description: A mod that adds random stuff like the nether in the overworld new recipes and villager trades and a cat mob that spawns in the plains at night
body: a random mod i made for fun! here is what it adds. Number 1 the HAHAHAHAHAHAHAHA a cat that acts like a zombie piglin meaning it attacks you if you hit it and its also really strong "only spawns in the plains" Number 2 New crafting recipes like for the brewing stand and more Number 3 new villager trades Number 4 the nether in the overworld "super rare biome" And why would you want to download this? because it adds more things. what do you expect?
